rules: BANNED for Main Headings: Inter, Open Sans, Roboto. Use Cabinet Grotesk or Outfit for primary headings.
Headlines > 32px MUST use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Never exceed text-6xl for H1 headlines on maximum viewports.
All text colors must achieve at least WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast against dark/light backgrounds.
No transparent dropdown or modal backgrounds under any circumstances (use bg-slate-900 or bg-white with backdrop-blur).
Forbidden colors for AI page: #7351B7. Forbidden font for dashboards: Space Grotesk.
Never use pure black #000000; use tinted dark slate #0B0F17.

phase_2_progressive_data_collection_map.strategy: Just-In-Time (JIT) compliance gates. Zero upfront friction; ask only at the exact moment a service requirement mandates it.

gates.why: Account creation, login authentication, legal consent

data_collected: Payment method (Stripe Credit Card or Crypto deposit)
gates.why: Payment processing and tax location validation

gates.trigger: Purchasing Phone Number requiring KYC (DID regulation)
data_collected: Legal Profile: Full Name (Individual) OR Business Name
Home Address OR Registered Business Address
gates.why: Telecom regulatory compliance for local DID allocation

gates.trigger: High-Risk or Restricted Country DID Purchase
gates.why: Strict anti-fraud telecom laws in specific international jurisdictions
gates.gated_until: Selecting a high-risk country number. Bypassed completely for Bot users & low-risk DIDs.

gates.why: Corporate billing verification and high-volume carrier throughput
gates.gated_until: Upgrading to Business/Enterprise plan or requesting custom trunks

gates.trigger: US 10DLC Campaign Registration (US Texting via Infobip/Multitel)
gates.why: US Carrier 10DLC regulatory registration to prevent spam blockages

component_usage_rules: Use Shadcn primitives for Modals, Dropdowns, DatePickers, Sonner Toasts.
Never use native HTML select or native standard date input.
Explicitly specify background classes on all popovers/dropdowns (e.g., bg-slate-900 text-slate-100 border-slate-800).
All interactive buttons and navigation links MUST include data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure every UI route and modal adheres strictly to this JSON blueprint. Implement progressive compliance triggers at checkout/number purchase only. Keep navigation concise with 4 core groups.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_requirement: All buttons, inputs, links, cards, tabs, and status indicators MUST carry kebab-case data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous 2-3x spacing scale using Tailwind p-6, p-8, gap-6.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: Never use transition: all. Specify target properties such as transition-colors or transition-opacity.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toasts: Use Sonner for toast notifications in frontend code.
